runs.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset: LEFT orthographic albedo texture-source paintover for the Mid hive spire. Produce exactly ONE 1024 x 1024 PNG with a genuine transparent background.
Inputs in order:
1. guide_left.png: EDIT TARGET and absolute authority for geometry, silhouette, position, scale, openings, and every shape edge. This is the exact model from its LEFT side.
2. design_reference.png: approved material and colour authority ONLY. Its three-quarter camera, extra sculptural details, lighting and background must not replace the guide geometry.
3. concept_crop.png: supporting original concept and palette.

Paint only the existing grey surface pixels of image 1. Preserve the guide's original alpha silhouette exactly, at identical pixel positions on its unchanged square canvas. Do not rotate, recenter, resize, crop, smooth, widen or redesign it. The guide occupies approximately x=244 through 780 and y=66 through 957; preserve those extents. All tapered tier contours, angular ribs, pointed tip, existing thorn shapes, inner openings, and flared base are locked to the guide. All transparent pixels, including internal gaps, remain transparent. Do not invent new holes, ribs, spikes, or protrusions.

Transfer the design's glossy wet black-violet resin/chitin material identity, orange slit-window/sac colours, and ivory bone thorns onto those exact existing shapes. Resin and chitin have dark plum-purple, black-violet base colour with subtle organic grain and marbling. Existing recessed window/sac surfaces are saturated orange/amber with restrained red-orange organic detail, painted at luminous colour. Existing bone tip/thorn surfaces are warm ivory with subtle natural streaks. Respect every guide boundary while placing these materials. Material grain is colour information only.

LIGHTING IS CRITICAL: this is unlit ALBEDO for texture projection, not a beauty render. Uniform flat shadowless frontal illumination, even colour visibility over the entire surface. No directional shading, cast shadows, ambient-occlusion darkening, baked-in specular hotspots or reflections, rim light, bloom or halos. Represent the glossy material through its base-colour character without bright lighting reflections. Orange sacs and seams do not cast light onto adjacent purple or ivory. No floor, scenery, opaque background, vignette, checkerboard pattern, text, or labels.
Return the original generated 1024 x 1024 image, ready to save as paint_left.png.
